mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.MENU_CD AS menuCd, m.MENU_NM AS menuNm, m.UPPER_MENU_CD AS upperMenuCd, m.MENU_URL AS menuUrl, m.MENU_ORDR AS menuOrdr FROM com_menu m WHERE m.USE_YN = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM com_role_menu rm JOIN com_role r ON rm.ROLE_CD = r.ROLE_CD WHERE rm.MENU_CD = m.MENU_CD AND rm.ACCS_YN = 'Y' AND rm.BASE_AUTH_YN = 'Y' AND r.USE_YN = 'Y' AND r.ROLE_LEVEL >= #{roleLevel} ) ORDER BY m.MENU_ORDR
